intro.heading: Our Projects
intro.support: Explore our completed, ongoing and upcoming residential communities across Vijayawada.

projects.name: Subhadra Residency
projects.imageAlt: Reference-based architectural illustration of Subhadra Residency
projects.description: Subhadra Residency is Datla Infra's first completed community — 20 thoughtfully designed apartments in Vijayawada, handed over on schedule in March 2023. It set the template every later Datla Infra project follows: honest construction, clear communication with owners, and communities built around everyday family life rather than just square footage.

projects.name: Sree Nivas Heights
projects.imageAlt: Reference-based architectural illustration of Sree Nivas Heights
projects.description: Sree Nivas Heights is currently under construction in Vijayawada — 50 apartments designed around the same principles of quality and community living that shaped Subhadra Residency. Detailed flat-level availability will appear here once construction milestones are confirmed.

projects.name: Datla Enclave
projects.imageAlt: Reference-based architectural illustration of Datla Enclave
projects.description: Datla Enclave is Datla Infra's upcoming premium community in Vijayawada, currently in the planning and design stage. Layouts, pricing and booking details will be published here as the project moves toward launch.
